rule_text.name: 702.206a
rule_text.rule: Reverberate is a keyword that represents a static ability and a triggered ability that function while the spell with reverberate is on the stack. “Reverberate (cost)” means “As an additional cost to cast this spell, you may pay (cost),” and “When you cast this spell, if you paid its reverberate cost, copy it. If the spell has any targets, you may choose new targets for the copy.”

rule_text.name: 702.206b
rule_text.rule: A spell is “reverberated” if it's a copy and it has reverberate.
